title: Concept: X-Runtime exposes per-request processing time
description: X-Runtime publishes how long each request took to process, so the timing profile of the application becomes observable without authentication. Differences between responses then mark the inputs that reach heavy code.
applicability: Responses produced by Ruby on Rails and by proxies that forward its headers.
risk: An attacker uses timing differences to detect blind injection and to find endpoints that touch expensive queries, without needing any error message from the application.
